content: Benzocaine (topical) is a local anesthetic that has been approved by the FDA for the treatment of dental pain. Common adverse reactions include contact dermatitis. For adult patients, benzocaine (topical) is intended for use on oral mucosa as directed by a dentist. There is limited information available regarding off-label guideline-supported or non-guideline-supported uses of benzocaine (topical) in adults. For pediatric patients, there is limited information regarding FDA-labeled use, off-label guideline-supported use, or off-label non-guideline-supported use of benzocaine (topical). The drug label provides limited information regarding contraindications and warnings for benzocaine (topical). Adverse reactions reported include contact dermatitis and, rarely, methemoglobinemia. There is limited information available regarding drug interactions with benzocaine (topical). Regarding use in specific populations: There is no FDA guidance on the use of benzocaine (topical) during pregnancy, labor and delivery, or in nursing mothers. There is no FDA guidance on its use in pediatric or geriatric patients. There is no FDA guidance on its use in specific gender or racial populations. There is no FDA guidance on its use in patients with renal or hepatic impairment. There is no FDA guidance on its use in females of reproductive potential, males, or immunocompromised patients. Benzocaine (topical) is administered topically. There is limited information regarding monitoring requirements for this medication. There is limited information available regarding IV compatibility, chronic overdose, the mechanism of action, structure, pharmacodynamics, pharmacokinetics, nonclinical toxicology, and clinical studies of benzocaine (topical). The drug should be stored at controlled room temperature, between 59–86°F (15–30°C). There is limited information regarding patient counseling for benzocaine (topical). The interaction between alcohol and benzocaine (topical) has not been established, and patients should consult their doctor about the effects of alcohol with this medication. The brand name for benzocaine (topical) is TOPICAL ANESTHETIC BANANA®. There is limited information regarding look-alike drug names for benzocaine (topical).
